title: Overlays and feedback
brief: Redesign sdeck-plus popovers, modal dialogs, hover and tooltip states, inline alerts, toasts and help popovers on the existing charcoal/violet/cyan system.

artboards.title: Quiet surfaces
artboards.tradeoff: Headed popovers with footers, calm modal on a scrim, tone-coloured alert panels and a plain toast with Undo. Closest to today's look; least new vocabulary.

artboards.title: Tonal feedback
artboards.tradeoff: Icon chips, a tone rail on alerts and a timer bar on toasts make state readable at a glance; the modal leads with a destructive icon. Slightly heavier, more components to maintain.

artboards.title: Compact command
artboards.tradeoff: Menu-style popovers with keyboard hints, banner alerts and a pill toast. Densest and fastest for experts; weaker explanation for infrequent, consequential actions.
